guide.title: Start publishing $FLOP content now

sourcedSteps.title: Follow Flop Labs on X

sourcedSteps.title: Follow Arthur Hayes for early terms
sourcedSteps.body: Follow CryptoHayes and subscribe to his Substack. His essays have carried more detail than the project account, including the 20% testnet figure, and more are coming. Terms tend to surface there first.

sourcedSteps.title: Apply for a network role
sourcedSteps.body: Open the Flop website and submit the form matching what you can deliver. Three of the four roles are open: GPU provider or miner: for anyone with hardware that can run inference. Miners earn block rewards plus payment per job. No minimum specifications have been published, so treat any circulating hardware requirement as unverified. Validator: confirms miners completed their assigned work and stores agent memory. Suited to people comfortable running nodes. KOL or creator: the lowest barrier of the three. A few solid posts plus the form is the entry price, and Substack counts, which helps if your X account is weak. The fourth role, Agents, is the demand side: they spend $FLOP rather than earn it, so there is nothing to apply for.
